feeStructure.typicalApplicationFeeNotes: Typical range; may vary by market.
feeStructure.typicalRoyaltyNotes: Typically applied to gross room revenue. Tiered or volume discounts may apply for multi-unit franchisees.
feeStructure.typicalMarketingFeeNotes: Contribution to brand marketing fund. May include loyalty program participation in some brands.
feeStructure.typicalTechnologyFeeNotes: Per property per year; covers CRS, PMS interfaces, and brand technology requirements.
feeStructure.typicalLoyaltyFeeNotes: Fee for participation in brand loyalty program (e.g., Marriott Bonvoy, Hilton Honors).
feeStructure.typicalIncentivesOffered: Flexible fee structure; lower base royalty; tiered or performance-based incentives; key money for strategic conversions.
feeStructure.ownerEarlyTerminationNotes: More flexible termination terms; fees often 1x annual or negotiated. Owner and brand may each have termination rights after cure period.
feeStructure.terminationFeeStructureNotes: Fees often 1x annual or negotiated. Soft brands typically more flexible than hard brands.
feeStructure.ownerFundedReserves: FF&E and PIP reserves; typically 4–6% of gross revenue. Flexible by property.

brandStandards.brandQaExpectations: Brand quality assurance; annual or semi-annual QA inspections; franchise standards compliance.

dealTerms.renewalConditions: Fee compliance, QA pass, required PIP and renovations per brand standards.

portfolioPerformance.analyticsPlatform: Brand analytics platform or approved equivalent
portfolioPerformance.apiIntegrations: OTAs (Expedia, Booking.com); payment processors; channel manager

formValues.pipRepositioningDetails: Conversion and renovation projects considered; PIP scope aligned with brand standards and market. New-build and expansion also considered.
formValues.capexSupport: Brand provides design and standards guidance; owner funds and executes CapEx and FF&E per approved plans. Typical reserve and FF&E replacement expectations apply.
formValues.knownRedFlags: Deals with unclear funding; aggressive revenue guarantees; markets with no comp set; owners unwilling to meet brand standards.
formValues.whoPaysForPIP: Owner-funded per standard franchise agreement; some conversion incentives available.

operationalSupport.keyMoneyPaymentTiming: Upon opening or at signing; may vary by deal.
operationalSupport.keyMoneyPaymentStructure: Pro rata repayment if terminated within 5–7 years; terms vary by agreement.
operationalSupport.keyMoneyClawbackTerms: Often 50% at LOI/brand approval, 50% at opening; negotiated.
operationalSupport.serviceDifferentiators: Comprehensive revenue management, sales and marketing, accounting, procurement, HR, technology, design, and development support per brand standards.
operationalSupport.decisionMaking: Owner approvals typically required for capital expenditures, major contracts, and budget variances. Brand approval for standards and PIP scope.
operationalSupport.disputeResolution: Escalation path from GM to regional to corporate. Mediation available. Typical resolution within 30–60 days for standard issues.
operationalSupport.industryRecognition: Brand standards, reporting, training, and support resources.
operationalSupport.specializations: Full-service and select-service segments; conversions and new builds; urban and suburban markets.
operationalSupport.testimonials: Multiple successful conversions and new-build openings in key markets. Owner references available upon request.
operationalSupport.ownerPortalFeatures: Monthly P&L, budget vs. actual, forecasts, operational metrics, brand standards, and support resources.
operationalSupport.ownerPortalNotes: Web-based portal with monthly financials, brand standards library, and pipeline reporting. Access to regional owner relations.
operationalSupport.ongoingSupportIncluded: Revenue management support, sales and marketing resources, accounting and financial reporting, procurement services, HR and training, technology support, design and renovation guidance, and development services per brand standards.
operationalSupport.crsParticipation: Full participation in brand CRS; central reservation system integration required for all properties.
operationalSupport.gdsParticipation: Yes; brand participates in major GDS channels (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport) for distribution.

legalTerms.aopRestrictions: No same-brand hotel within AOP during Term
legalTerms.loiTimeline: Parties agree to negotiate in good faith and execute a definitive agreement within 90-120 days of LOI execution
legalTerms.terminationForCause: Pro rata repayment if terminated within 7 years
legalTerms.terminationWithoutCause: Pro rata repayment if terminated within 7 years
legalTerms.terminationOnSale: Pro rata repayment if terminated within 7 years
legalTerms.liquidatedDamages: 2.5x annual royalty fee or fixed amount if terminated early
legalTerms.loiNonBinding: All other terms pending execution of definitive agreements
legalTerms.legalConfidentiality: Both parties agree to maintain confidentiality of this LOI and all related discussions.
legalTerms.conditionsPrecedent: Subject to approval by franchisor's development committee, successful site review, financials, and legal diligence.
legalTerms.buyoutTransferProvisions: Standard buyout and transfer provisions per agreement. Transfer typically requires brand approval and may include assignment fee. Owner may assign to qualified transferee.
legalTerms.assignmentRestrictions: Assignment permitted to qualified transferee with brand approval. Transferee must assume all obligations. Notice and approval process required.
